name: Guns GirlZ: Operation Gekkou - Reborn
source: Operation Gekkou is the effort to turn the story of GGZ into a Visual Novel with refurbished English translations. It is intended to make the story more accessible to the English speaking audience, as well as improve upon the text and translations.
translation: “月光行动”（Operation Gekkou）是一项致力于将《崩坏学园2》的剧情改编为视觉小说并重新打磨英文译文的项目，旨在改良文本与翻译质量，让英语圈玩家能够更便捷地接触并体验这段故事。
